edges.wires: C-003.flags (Namespace{utc,time}) feeds C-000's branch logic (which clock mode and whether to append time).
edges.compose_note: main() calls parse_args(argv) first; on bad flags argparse raises SystemExit (non-zero) before any other component runs.

edges.wires: C-001.now (datetime) supplies the instant to format. main() calls now(utc=flags.utc).
edges.compose_note: Clock mode is selected by the parsed --utc flag from C-003.

edges.wires: C-002.line (str) is the exact text main() prints to stdout. main() calls format_line(now, flags.time).
edges.compose_note: Formatter consumes C-001.now and C-003.flags.time; its output string is the product's stdout.

composability_check.argv_source: external (sys.argv) — Assumption: provided by the OS shell, not an internal component.
composability_check.notes: Every required input of the root C-000 is produced by a child output. argv is the only external input and is documented as an Assumption.
